reference: Look at that duck! It is going to steal the sandwich.
sk: Pozri na tú kačku! Hneď ten sendvič ukradne
cz: Podívej na tu kachnu! Hned ten sendvič ukradne
acceptable: Look at that duck! It is going to steal {the|that} sandwich{| any second| any moment| in a second}.

mistakes.text: Look at that duck! It will steal the sandwich.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Keď to už vidíme, patrí „is going to“, nie „will“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Když to už vidíme, patří „is going to“, ne „will“.

mistakes.text: Look at that duck! It is going to steals the sandwich.
Look at that duck! It going to steal the sandwich.
Look at that duck! It steals the sandwich.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Tu patrí „is going to“: „It is going to steal“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Tady patří „is going to“: „It is going to steal“.

mistakes.text: Look on that duck! It is going to steal the sandwich.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Podívej se na = „look at“, ne „look on“.

mistakes.text: Look at that duck! It is about to steal the sandwich.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Precvič tu „is going to“: „It is going to steal“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvič tady „is going to“: „It is going to steal“.

source_issues: Native sentences add 'Hneď/Hned' (right away) and 'ten/ten sendvič' (that sandwich); 'any second' variants accepted.
